name: browser-public-test-approved-space
description: Test approved-space - Permit approved keyboard confirmation

args.code: new Promise(function(res,rej){var t0=Date.now();(function tick(){try{res((function(){var e=document.querySelector("p");if(!e)throw new Error("ASSERT FAIL approved-space.3: p not found");var t=e.innerText.trim();if(t.indexOf("Submitted")<0)throw new Error("ASSERT FAIL approved-space.3: expected Submitted, got "+t);return t;})());}catch(e){if(Date.now()-t0>5000)rej(e);else setTimeout(tick,200);}})();})
